record.body:
verdict: PASS
findings: []
integration:
  interfaces: "Landed: the `orchestra` package (cli, install, contract, project-field, sessions, reviewer, suite, store) with a `pyproject.toml` console script and a `bin/orchestra` shim; a checkout-side `installer/` that loads `installer/providers.json`, builds per-host adapters (`installer/adapters/{base,native}.py`), selects providers (`installer/runner.py`), and plans/applies/verifies/uninstalls; native Claude/Cursor/OpenCode payloads plus a generic `npx skills add -a <profile>` tail (with plain-skills fallback); `scripts/build_skills.py` copies `shared/{ensure-store,kinds-and-focus}.md` into each `skills/*/references/` and renders `agents/reviewer.prompt.md` into per-host `agents/se-reviewer.md`; `hosts/*` supplies hook payloads, with Claude hooks merged into `.claude/settings.json` and the legacy `hooks/hooks.json` copy retained; README's host matrix is asserted against the same provider matrix the installer and tests read."
  assumptions: "Reviewed only the restricted brief (work items/Approach, acceptance criteria, specification, design, and `git diff main..HEAD`) and the tree at b4730601; no execution-report, check-run, assessment, or assignment material was used (none needed). Read `--all` in the design as 'every recognized native host plus the generic tail', i.e. every matrix row, which is what README and tests state; read the acceptance's temp-HOME requirement as substantively satisfied by `tests/integration/test_temp_home_install.py` driving `python -m orchestra.cli` with the documented flags rather than by `tests/test_readme_matrix.py` literally executing `./bin/orchestra`. Did not reopen done tasks."
  invariants: "Checked and held: generated `references/*.md` are byte-identical to `shared/` and `skills/execute-phase/references/se-reviewer.md` matches the canonical prompt; `render('claude', load(root))` equals `agents/se-reviewer.md`; rendered OpenCode agent emits `mode: subagent`, plural `permissions:`, `read/grep/glob/bash: allow`, `edit: deny`, `webfetch: deny`, and no inert `write:`/`apply_patch`; installer copy allowlist excludes `.artifacts/`, `.worktrees/`, and dashboard/store state (R14); re-running install is idempotent and uninstall restores pre-existing Claude `settings.json`; skills-reference portability rejects planted `../` paths; installed-prefix CLI starts and works without an affidavit checkout; OpenCode payload lands at `plugins/plugin.js` with no root `plugin.js`; no `--list` usage remains. Only read-only commands were used; no tree or store writes were made."
  conflicts: "Non-blocking inconsistencies for the parent to reconcile: (1) Design Interfaces says `--all` selects every *detected* native host, but `select_providers` returns every matrix provider and `BaseAdapter.detect()` is not consulted by selection; README ('Select every provider in the matrix'), `test_flags_all_installs_every_matrix_provider`, and the implementation agree with each other, so the design wording is the odd one out. (2) The acceptance says `tests/test_readme_matrix.py` proves a temporary-HOME install follows the README commands as written; that file only compares README text/matrix and `--help`, while the temp-HOME install is in `tests/integration/test_temp_home_install.py`, uses `python -m orchestra.cli` rather than the README's `./bin/orchestra`, and no test executes the shim for `install` (the shim itself is a trivial `sys.path` + `main` launcher). (3) `tests/test_readme_matrix.py`'s `"two levels above" not in section` passes only because README wraps that phrase across a newline; the README prose is correct ('no shared file needs to sit two levels above a `SKILL.md`'), so this is a fragile negative assertion, not a delivered defect."
record.subject: cross-harness-install-review
